title: Can Lessons From Human Teams Be Applied to Multi-Agent Systems? The Role of Structure, Diversity, and Interaction Dynamics

bias_targets.methodology: Assigning specific gender personas (male, female) to LLM agents to evaluate how demographic identity impacts multi-agent team reasoning performance and interaction dynamics.
Assigning specific age-based personas (e.g., young adult, senior) to LLM agents to evaluate how demographic identity impacts multi-agent team reasoning performance and interaction dynamics.
Assigning specific racial/ethnic personas (White, Black, Asian) to LLM agents to evaluate how demographic identity impacts multi-agent team reasoning performance and interaction dynamics.

Assigning specific occupational personas (white-collar, blue-collar) to LLM agents to evaluate how socioeconomic and professional identity impacts multi-agent team reasoning performance and interaction dynamics.
